summary: Natuzzi S.p.A., the NYSE-listed Italian furniture maker, filed a Form 6-K announcing Aldo Uva's appointment to its Board of Directors, effective after the September 11, 2026 shareholder meeting approved expanding board size; he is expected to be named CEO in the first half of October 2026. Uva, who previously led Natuzzi from May 2008 to March 2009, is tasked with an industrial and operational turnaround focused on simplifying the business, streamlining operations, reshaping the cost base, and restoring profitability and cash generation. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed; watch execution risk and potential strategic actions.
